security_frame.attacker: A local attacker able to observe the power or electromagnetic side channel of the Caliptra HMAC block while it computes over a key it cannot read, optionally combined with software that can write the HMAC LFSR seed register.
security_frame.precondition: The HMAC block is used with its masked SHA-512 cores, which is the only configuration the tree instantiates.
security_frame.input: Any ordinary HMAC operation. No malformed or unusual input is required: the weak reseed happens on every INIT.
security_frame.protected_asset: The HMAC key and the intermediate state of the keyed hash, protected against side-channel recovery by the masking of the SHA-512 cores.
security_frame.security_property: The masking PRNGs must be reseeded from a hardware-derived, software-unpredictable value, so that mask sequences cannot be predicted or replayed across operations.
security_frame.modification: hmac_core.sv presents the entropy block to the H2 masked core at line 282 but never asserts H2_init or H2_next for it (lines 274-283 hold both strobes at 0). H2 is therefore never started on that block, so the set_entropy latch at lines 229-231 captures the unstarted core's output.

security_feature_bypassed: Hardware-derived reseeding of the HMAC masking PRNGs, the entropy source for the block's first-order side-channel countermeasure
proof_goal: Show that the reseed chain the file builds is broken in the middle: the entropy block is presented to H2 and H2's digest is latched, but H2 is never started, so entropy_digest takes the unstarted core's value. Show the consequence that lfsr_entropy collapses to the software-written LFSR_SEED register alone. Show the same testbench rejects the claim once H2 is started from that same first_round arm.

proof_style.primary: structural audit of the audited RTL against its own idiom
secondary: directed unit-level simulation of hmac_core with cover counters
negative control on a patched scratch copy

minimum_attack_sequence: Software issues an ordinary HMAC INIT, which is the normal way to start a keyed hash. No privileged or unusual action is needed.
The FSM enters CTRL_IPAD and presents entropy_block to H2, but never starts H2, so H2 produces no digest for it.
At the IPAD to OPAD transition set_entropy fires and latches entropy_digest from the unstarted core's output, which out of reset is zero.
lfsr_entropy becomes entropy_digest XOR lfsr_seed, which reduces to lfsr_seed: the 12 masking LFSRs are seeded from a value software wrote.
The attacker, knowing or having written LFSR_SEED, knows the mask sequence for the operation and can strip the masking from a side-channel trace.
expected_evidence: hmac_core.sv:243 builds entropy_block from entropy_digest, lfsr_seed and a counter; hmac_core.sv:282 presents it on H2_block inside CTRL_IPAD.

hmac_core.sv:229-231 latches entropy_digest from H2_digest when set_entropy fires, and hmac_core.sv:362 fires set_entropy at the IPAD to OPAD transition. The file therefore intends H2 to have hashed that block.
The CTRL_IPAD first_round arm drives H2_init and H2_next to 0 (hmac_core.sv:277-278) and no assignment in the whole CTRL_IPAD branch ever raises either strobe.

In-file control: every other block presentation in the same always_comb block is accompanied by a start strobe. H1_init at :275, H1_next and H2_init at :290-291, H2_next at :304. A computed census finds exactly 4 start-strobe assertions in the file, one per real block presentation and none for the entropy block.
hmac_core.sv:126 and :145 wire the LFSR output into both masked cores' entropy ports, so the seed is the masking countermeasure's randomness.
hmac.sv:311 sources lfsr_seed from the software-writable HMAC512_LFSR_SEED register and hmac.sv:159-160 passes it straight through, so the surviving seed component is software-controlled.
In simulation, over the whole CTRL_IPAD window no H2 start strobe is ever asserted, entropy_digest latches zero, and lfsr_entropy equals the software-written seed exactly.
With H2 started from the same first_round arm in a scratch copy, the identical testbench sees a real digest latched, all three cover counters fall to zero and the self-checks fail.
success_criteria: Every structural gate holds, including the computed census that the file asserts a start strobe for every block presentation except the entropy one.
The simulation shows no H2 start strobe across the entire CTRL_IPAD window, while the H1 control check confirms start strobes do reach the cores in that same window.
The negative control fails on corrected RTL with all three covers at zero, and its H1 control check still passes.
The finding is anchored on the audited tree's own reseed chain and its own start-strobe idiom.
